purpose: Natural-prevalence validation of the four frozen neural panel fits and the existing fixed tree reference
selection_rule: Report every fixed final-epoch model and seed, plus the single unchanged tree reference; no automatic promotion
limits: No tuning of architecture, optimizer, epochs, class weights, feature preprocessing, calibration or alert thresholds
Open validation arrays only after every neural fit and the fixed tree reproduce their archived training receipts
Keep the full validation matrix disk-backed; materialize only bounded batches
Validation has been used in prior exploratory work; final test remains sealed
Panel and natural validation prevalence differ; a macro-F1 gap alone is not pure overfitting evidence
These centrally pooled panel fits are not full-2M or federated training runs
